title: Counting Missed Appointments on a HomeCare Coverage
content:
For a missed-appointment charge on a Calloway Limited Home Warranty coverage, the count of missed appointments is taken as follows.

**Whose coverage.** For the missed-appointment charge only the missed appointments recorded on the homeowner's own coverage are counted, never those recorded on a previous owner's coverage of the same home.

**Which missed appointments enter the count.** Which missed appointments enter the count is settled by the coverage's history:

1. where a missed-appointment charge has been waived on the coverage, every missed appointment recorded on the coverage is counted less one for each waived charge, because a miss that followed Calloway's own short-notice reschedule is not the homeowner's miss;
2. where no charge has been waived and the coverage start date is 24 or more whole calendar months before the assessment day, only the missed appointments whose appointment date is later than the same calendar day 24 months before the assessment day are counted;
3. in every other case every missed appointment recorded on the coverage is counted, the one being charged included.

## Truth table

| Any charge waived on the coverage | Coverage start date 24 or more whole calendar months before the assessment day | Count |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Every missed appointment on the coverage, less one per waived charge |
| Yes | No | Every missed appointment on the coverage, less one per waived charge |
| No | Yes | Only missed appointments dated later than the same calendar day 24 months before the assessment day |
| No | No | Every missed appointment on the coverage |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

- Coverage start date 10 May 2023, no waiver. Assessed 10 May 2025: 24 whole calendar months, so only appointments dated later than 10 May 2023 count; an appointment dated 10 May 2023 is not counted, one dated 11 May 2023 is. Assessed 9 May 2025: 23 whole calendar months, so every missed appointment on the coverage counts.
- Five missed appointments are recorded and one charge has been waived: the count is 4, whatever the age of the coverage.
